**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: APPROVED**

**Service:** Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43775)  
**Order Date:** June 23, 2025  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]

---

Your prior authorization request for laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy has been **APPROVED**.

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement (≥35 kg/m²):** Met. Most recent BMI is 36.2 kg/m² documented June 16, 2025 (7 days prior to order).

**Obesity-Related Comorbidity:** Met. Patient has Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications (active since March 8, 2022), an approved comorbid condition.

**Prior Weight Management:** Met. Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial. Net weight loss of 2 kg was regained after discontinuation. Treating physician documented this as unsuccessful.

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43775) is a covered bariatric procedure.

---

This authorization is valid for 60 days from this letter. Please contact our office if you have questions or if the procedure date changes.
